_comment: Punjab National Bank — Real-world profile derived from FY2025 Annual Report & Directors Report
_source: Directors Report FY2025 (indiainfoline.com/pnb), Business Standard Q4FY25, PNB Investor Presentation
_note_balance_sheet: Total Assets est. ~Rs 17,50,000 cr; Net Advances (domestic) Rs 9,42,391 cr; Total Deposits Rs 15,10,456 cr (FY2025). Domestic advances include Rs 6,75,725 cr RAM (56.6%); global advances est. ~Rs 10,00,000 cr.
_note_deposits: CASA 37.95% of deposits (FY2025). Current/Demand ~5.25%, Savings ~32.7%, Term ~62.0%. PNB is a strong retail deposit franchise — savings share significantly higher than BoB.
_note_exposure: Domestic loan mix FY2025: Corporate/Large ~35%, Retail+Agri mapped to RETAIL_OTHER ~40%, MSME 17%, Housing/Mortgages 8%. RAM segment = 56.6% of domestic advances (Retail + Agri + MSME).
_note_credit_quality: GNPA improved 178 bps YoY to 3.95% as of March 2025 (from 5.73% in FY2024). Net NPA 0.40%. Significant improvement from peak ~14% in FY2020 post Nirav Modi fraud.
_note_pnl: NII Rs 42,782 cr / Total Assets Rs 17,50,000 cr = NIM 2.81%. ROA 0.99%, Net Profit grew 101.7% YoY to Rs 16,630 cr for FY2025. Cost-income ~52%.
_note_capital: CRAR 17.01%, CET1 12.33% as of March 2025. Well above RBI minimums (CRAR 11.5%, CET1 8%).
